diseases.name: Ischemic Stroke
recommended_interventions: dysphagia screening prior to oral intake
contraindications: thrombolysis if INR > 1.7
thrombolysis with active intracranial hemorrhage
oral intake prior to dysphagia screening
aggressive blood pressure reduction > 15% in first 24h without thrombolysis
hypotonic intravenous fluids

diseases.name: Intracerebral Hemorrhage
recommended_interventions: intensive blood pressure control (target SBP < 140 mmHg)
contraindications: intravenous thrombolysis (alteplase or tenecteplase)
therapeutic anticoagulation
antiplatelet administration in acute phase
lumbar puncture prior to neuroimaging
excessive neck flexion impairing cerebral venous drainage

diseases.name: Cervical Spinal Cord Injury
recommended_interventions: serial forced vital capacity and respiratory mechanics monitoring
contraindications: unprotected cervical spine manipulation
succinylcholine administration beyond 48 hours post-injury
routine high-dose methylprednisolone outside evidence window
prolonged supine positioning without pressure injury prophylaxis
unmonitored bladder distension triggering autonomic dysreflexia

diseases.name: COPD Exacerbation
recommended_interventions: non-invasive positive pressure ventilation (BiPAP) for hypercapnic acidosis
antibiotic therapy when bacterial infection suspected
contraindications: uncontrolled high-flow oxygen targeting SpO2 > 96%
non-selective beta-blockers
respiratory depressants (opioids or sedatives) without airway protection
delayed non-invasive ventilation in acute hypercapnic acidosis (pH < 7.35)

diseases.name: Guillain-Barre Syndrome
recommended_interventions: serial forced vital capacity and negative inspiratory force monitoring
elective endotracheal intubation if FVC < 20 mL/kg
contraindications: oral or intravenous corticosteroids as monotherapy
succinylcholine during intubation due to hyperkalemia risk
premature discharge prior to respiratory plateau verification
high-intensity fatiguing resistance exercise in acute demyelinating phase

diseases.name: Community-Acquired Pneumonia
expected_symptoms: focal crackles or bronchial breath sounds
recommended_interventions: blood and sputum cultures in severe presentations
contraindications: delayed antibiotic administration in septic patients
routine systemic corticosteroids in non-severe pneumonia without indication
aggressive chest percussion with severe hemoptysis or coagulopathy
antitussive cough suppressants impairing mucociliary clearance

diseases.name: Myasthenia Gravis
recommended_interventions: intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG) or plasmapheresis in myasthenic crisis
serial forced vital capacity and negative inspiratory force monitoring
early airway protection for impending neuromuscular respiratory failure
pyridostigmine therapy (withheld during mechanical ventilation crisis)
contraindications: aminoglycoside antibiotics
fluoroquinolone antibiotics
magnesium sulfate infusion
beta-blockers
high-dose corticosteroid initiation without inpatient respiratory monitoring
standard-dose non-depolarizing neuromuscular blocking agents

diseases.name: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome
recommended_interventions: lung-protective mechanical ventilation (tidal volume 4-6 mL/kg PBW)
PEEP titration maintaining plateau pressure <= 30 cmH2O
conservative fluid management after shock resolution
early ICU mobilization and post-ICU cardiopulmonary neurorehabilitation
contraindications: high tidal volume ventilation (> 8 mL/kg PBW)
excessive positive fluid balance without hemodynamic indication
routine high-frequency oscillatory ventilation
prolonged deep sedation preventing spontaneous awakening trials when stable

loinc_labs.name: Oxygen saturation in Arterial blood by Pulse oximetry
loinc_labs.clinical_significance: Monitors arterial oxygenation; target 88-92% in hypercapnic COPD exacerbations.

loinc_labs.name: pH of Arterial blood
loinc_labs.clinical_significance: Detects acute respiratory acidosis (< 7.35) requiring NIV or intubation.

loinc_labs.name: Carbon dioxide [Partial pressure] in Arterial blood
loinc_labs.clinical_significance: Quantifies alveolar ventilation; elevated in COPD exacerbation and neuromuscular respiratory failure.

loinc_labs.name: INR in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay
loinc_labs.clinical_significance: Assesses coagulation status; INR > 1.7 contraindicates IV thrombolysis in acute ischemic stroke.

loinc_labs.name: Potassium [Moles/volume] in Serum or Plasma
loinc_labs.clinical_significance: Critical arrhythmia marker; hyperkalemia risk amplified by succinylcholine in SCI and Guillain-Barre syndrome.

loinc_labs.name: Oxygen [Partial pressure] in Arterial blood
loinc_labs.clinical_significance: Measures arterial oxygen tension; used with FiO2 to grade ARDS severity.

loinc_labs.name: Bicarbonate [Moles/volume] in Arterial blood
loinc_labs.clinical_significance: Distinguishes acute versus chronic renal compensation in hypercapnic respiratory failure.

loinc_labs.name: Lactate [Moles/volume] in Arterial blood
loinc_labs.clinical_significance: Evaluates tissue hypoperfusion in severe community-acquired pneumonia, sepsis, and neurogenic shock.

loinc_labs.name: Glucose [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma
loinc_labs.clinical_significance: Rules out hypoglycemia as a stroke mimic prior to thrombolytic therapy.

loinc_labs.name: Platelets [#/volume] in Blood by Automated count
loinc_labs.clinical_significance: Evaluates bleeding risk; platelet count < 100 x 10^3/uL contraindicates IV thrombolysis.
